projects.title: Rural Community Hub & Spatial Planning
projects.short_description: An architectural spatial design project and interactive map interface for planning community resource centers in rural districts.
projects.full_description: This project combines architectural spatial planning with a web-based interactive map. It helps regional planners view facility distribution, calculate access distances, and review architectural 3D building concepts for rural community centers.
projects.problem: Local administrative offices lacked visual mapping tools and clear architectural floorplans when proposing new rural community centers.
projects.solution: Designed a modular 3D building blueprint alongside an interactive web map showing resource coverage zones.
features: Interactive map view displaying local health post and school locations
Architectural floorplans and 3D Lumion renderings for the community building
Distance and travel time calculations for nearby villages
projects.challenges: Balancing detailed CAD drawings with a fast, lightweight web interface.
projects.results: Helped local officers present clear 3D visuals and spatial data during municipal budget reviews.

projects.title: Sugandhika Artisanal E-Commerce Store
projects.short_description: A minimalist online store designed for a local Himalayan essential oil brand, featuring scent profiles and order management.
projects.full_description: Sugandhika is an e-commerce website built for an organic Himalayan fragrance brand. It features a clean product gallery, scent note descriptions, simple shopping cart drawer, and a back-end admin area to manage inventory.
projects.problem: The brand needed an elegant website that showcased their handcrafted products without feeling like a noisy marketplace.
projects.solution: Created a warm off-white design with soft typography, product scent note diagrams, and an easy checkout flow.
features: Product showcase with scent note visualizers (Top, Heart, Base notes)
Slide-out shopping cart drawer with instant item updating
Admin panel for updating product listings and viewing customer messages
projects.challenges: Keeping images crisp and fast-loading across mobile connections.
projects.results: Improved customer inquiries and online order requests by 40%.

projects.title: Modern Urban Villa & 3D Visuals
projects.short_description: A modern 3-story residential villa design complete with structural CAD drawings, 3D renderings, and daylight analysis.
projects.full_description: Designed a modern 3-story residential villa focused on natural ventilation and daylighting. Delivered full architectural working drawings, 3D SketchUp models, and high-resolution Lumion renderings for the client.
projects.problem: The client needed a compact house design for a narrow urban plot while maximizing indoor daylight and ventilation.
projects.solution: Designed a vertical floorplan with a central light courtyard and exterior timber louvers for solar shading.
features: Complete AutoCAD floorplans, elevations, and structural section drawings
3D Lumion exterior and interior photorealistic visual renders
Sun path and daylighting shadow analysis
Material specification schedule for construction contractor
projects.challenges: Working within tight municipal setback rules while keeping room sizes spacious.
projects.results: Client approved the schematic design on the first presentation review.

about.heading: Designing physical spaces and building modern web applications.
about.introduction: I'm Bipal Kattel, a Junior Architect and Web Developer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. I enjoy combining architectural design, 3D spatial modeling, and clean web development to create simple, functional products.
about.biography:
My background spans architectural design, spatial planning, and digital web development. I hold a Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch) degree and spend my time creating architectural drawings, 3D renderings, and building responsive web applications.

I believe good design—whether a building blueprint or a web interface—should be simple, purposeful, and easy to navigate. I enjoy taking an idea from initial sketch to final presentation.

education.details: Studied spatial design, structural planning, AutoCAD drafting, 3D modeling, and sustainable building design.
Focused on Physics, Mathematics, and Computer Science.

about.philosophy: Keep design clean, functional, and simple. Strip away non-essential clutter and focus on usability.
